questions.question: A number is increased by 30%, then decreased by 25% and then further increased by 25%. What is the net increase/decrease percent in the number (correct to the nearest integer)?
questions.solution:
Net percentage change using formula = x + y + xy/100

For first two changes,

⇒ +30 + (-25) + [30 × (-25)]/100 = -2.5% 

For further third change,

-2.5 + 25 + [(-2.5) × 25]/100 = 21.875%

⇒ 22% increase (approx.)

questions.question: If a 10-digit number 1220x558y2 is divisible by 88, then the value of (x + y) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A number 1220x558y2 is divisible by 88

**Concept used:**

• If a number is divisible by 88 then it must be divisible by 11 & 8

• If a number ABCD is divisible by 11 then (A + C) - (B + D) = 0 or multiple of 11 

**Calculation:**

The difference between the sum of alternative terms should be 0.

⇒ 1 + 2 + x + 5 + y = 2 + 0 + 5 + 8 + 2

⇒ x + y = 9

**∴ The correct answer is 9**

questions.question: 10 years ago, the average age of a family of five members was 38 years. Now, two new members join, whose age difference is 8 years. If the present average age of the family is the same as it was 10 years ago, What is the age (in years) of the new younger member?
questions.solution:
Total age of family 10 years ago = 38 × 5 = 190 years

Total age at present of the family = 38 × 7 = 266 years

Age of 5 members increased = 5 × 10 = 50 years

Difference of total age then and now = 266 – (190 + 50) = 26 (sum of ages of new members)

Let the two members be x and y.

X + y = 26

X – y = 8

On solving two equations,

X = 17 and y = 9

Age of younger member = 9

questions.question: If (x - 7)³ + (x - 8)³ + (x + 6)³ = 3 (x - 7)(x - 8) (x + 6), then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(x - 7)3 + (x - 8)3 + (x + 6)3 = 3 (x - 7)(x - 8) (x + 6)

**Concept used:**

If a3 + b3 + c3 = 3abc then a + b + c = 0

**Calculation:**

Let (x - 7),(x - 8), and (x + 6) be a, b and c respectively

Now the equation can be written as,

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc

Using the above concept, we can write,

⇒ a + b + c = 0 

⇒ (x - 7) + (x - 8) + (x + 6) = 0 [ put the values of a, b, c ]

⇒ 3x = 9

⇒ x = 3

**∴ The value of x is 3**

questions.question: If cos θ = 2p/(p² + 1), then sin θ is equal to:
questions.solution:
cos θ = 2p/(p² + 1)

On squaring both the side,

⇒ cos² θ = 4p²/(p² + 1)²

⇒ 1 – sin² θ = 4p²/(p² + 1)²

⇒ sin² θ = 1 - 4p²/(p² + 1)²

⇒ sin² θ = [(p² + 1)² - 4p²]/(p² + 1)²

⇒ sin² θ = (p² - 1)² /(p² + 1)²

⇒ sin θ = (p² - 1)/(p² + 1).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

cos θ = 2p/(p2 + 1)

cos θ = 2p/(p2 + 1) = Base(B)/Hypotenuse(H)

By Pythagoras theorem 

⇒ (P)² + (B)² = (H)² 

⇒ (P)² + (2p)² = (p2 + 1)2

⇒ (P)2 + 4p2 = (p2 + 1)2

⇒ (P)2 = (p2 + 1)2 - 4p²

⇒ (P)2 = p⁴ + 1 + 2p² - 4p2

⇒ (P)2 = (p2 - 1)2

⇒ P = p2 - 1

now, 

sin θ = Perpendicular(P)/Hypotenuse(H)

⇒ sin θ = (p2 - 1)(p2 + 1)

**∴ sin θ = (p2 - 1)(p2 + 1)**

questions.question: What is the area of rhombus (in cm)² whose side is 10 cm and the smaller diagonal is 12 cm?
questions.solution:
There are different ways of doing it, one method is as follows…..

Rhombus ABCD, AB = 10 cm, So BC = 10 cm, as all sides of rhombus are equal.

Diagonal AC = 12 cm

So, area of triangle ABC by Heron's formula

= √{ s(s - a)(s - b)(s - c)}, s is semi perimeter & a, b, c are sides of the triangle

= s = 32/2 = 16

Area = √{16(16 – 10)(16 – 10)(16 – 12)

⇒ area = √(16 × 6 × 6 × 4)

⇒ area = √(2² × 2² × 2² × 3² × 2²)

⇒ area = 2 × 2 × 2 × 3 × 2 = 48 cm²

⇒ area (Rhombus ABCD) = 48 × 2 = 96 cm²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The side of a rhombus is 10 cm and the smaller diagonal is 12 cm

**Concept use:**

• All sides of a rhombus are equal

• Diagonals of a rhombus bisect each other at a right angle (90°)

• Area of a rhombus = 1/2 × (product of two diagonals)

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/116e629271658daea850c0c1dc802fd17e5d860018e2531dbbea3292a14aaf11.png] 

Let ABCD be the rhombus, where AC and BD be the diagonals intersecting at point O

Here, AC = 12, then OC = 6 and BC = 10

Now, ΔBOC is a right-angle triangle where right angle at O

So, BO = √(10² - 6²) = 8

So, BD = 8 × 2 = 16 cm

Now, area of the rhombus is 1/2 × 16 × 12 = 96 cm²

**∴ The area of the rhombus is 96 cm2**

questions.question: In which year the percentage increase in the total number of students is the highest in comparison to the previous academic year?
questions.solution:
Total number of student in 2013-2014 is (150 + 100) = 250

Total number of student in 2041-20015 is (200 + 100) = 300

Total number of student in 2015-2016 is (300 + 50) = 350

Total number of student in 2016-2017 is (250 + 100) = 350

Total number of student in 2017-2018 is (300 + 100) = 400

From 2014-15 the increase in number of students = (300 – 250)/250 × 100 = 20%

From 2015-16 the increase in number of students = (350 – 300)/300 × 100 = 16.66%

From 2016-17 the increase in number of students = (350 – 350)/350 × 100 = 0%

From 2017-18 the increase in number of students = (400 – 350)/350 × 100 = 14.28%

∴ the number of students increasing percentage is maximum for year 2014-15.

questions.question: If (x - 1/x) = 10, then (x³ - 1/x³) is equal to:
questions.solution:

**Calculation:**

(x - 1/x) = 10 (x - 1/x) = 10

on cubing both the side,

⇒ (x - 1/x)³ = 10³

⇒ (x³ - 1/x³ - 3(x × 1/x)(x – 1/x) = 1000

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work in 10, 20 and 60 days respectively. Working together, they can complete the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
Given:

A can do the work = 10 days

B can do the work = 20 days

C can do the work = 60 days

Calculation:

One-day work of A = 1/10 days ----(1)

One-day work of B = 1/20 days ----(2)

One-day work of C = 1/60 days ----(3)

Adding equations (1), (2) and (3), we get

One-day work of (A + B + C) = {(1/10) + (1/20) + (1/60)}

⇒ (A + B + C) = {(6 + 3 + 1)/60}

⇒ (A + B + C) = 10/60 = 1/6

One-day work of (A + B + C) = 1/6 days 

∴ The total work will be completed in 6 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Total work in units = LCM of the time taken by them individually.

LCM = total work = 60

Efficiency of A = 60/10 = 6 units per day. (Efficiency = total work/time) 

Efficiency of B = 60/20 = 3 units per day. (Efficiency = total work/time) 

Efficiency of C = 60/60 = 1 unit per day. (Efficiency = total work/time)

Working together they will complete = 60/(6 + 3 + 1) = 6 days

questions.question: A train covers 360 km at a uniform speed. If the speed had been 10 km/h more, it would have taken 3 hours less for the same journey. What is the speed of the train (in km/h)?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Use the **product of speeds** formula: **Distance = [s₁ × s₂ ÷ (s₂ − s₁)] × Time Difference**

360 = [v × (v + 10) ÷ 10] × 3

⇒ 120 × 10 = v(v + 10)

⇒ 1200 = 30 × 40

**∴ The correct answer is 30 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total **Distance** = 360 km, **Speed increase** = 10 km/h, **Time decrease** = 3 hours.

**Formula Used:** Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4b307fff10ab4275c1e9bd898c155e056ccbcb0eae27e76e883d2b3d98ebcd8.png] 

⇒ Let the **original speed** be 'v' km/h.

⇒ Original Time (t₁) = 360/v

⇒ New Time (t₂) = 360/(v + 10)

⇒ Difference: t₁ − t₂ = 3

⇒ 360/v − 360/(v + 10) = 3

⇒ 120/v − 120/(v + 10) = 1

⇒ 120(v + 10 − v) = v(v + 10)

⇒ 1200 = v² + 10v

⇒ v² + 10v − 1200 = 0

⇒ (v + 40)(v − 30) = 0

⇒ Since speed cannot be negative, v = 30 km/h.

**∴ The correct answer is 30 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

For the same distance covered at speeds a and b, Average Speed = 2ab ÷ (a + b).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in the **opposite direction**, relative speed is (s₁ + s₂). In the **same direction**, it is |s₁ − s₂|.

Speed-Time Relation

If distance is **constant**, Speed is **inversely proportional** to Time (s₁ × t₁ = s₂ × t₂).</p

questions.question: Rs. 60000 invested at a certain rate for a certain even number of years, compounded annually, grows to Rs. 63,654. To how much amount would it grow if it is invested on compound interrest at the same rate for half the period?
questions.solution:
The formula for calculating the amount is A = P(1 + r/100)ⁿ

where A = Amount, P = Principal, r = Rate of interest in % and n = Number of years

In this case both r and n are not known but P and A are given.

We have 63654 = 60,000 × (1 + r/100)ⁿ

Therefore (1 + r/100)ⁿ = 63654/60000 .

When the period is halved the formula for Amount A₁ becomes

A₁ = 60000(1 + r/100)ⁿ/²

Hence the multiplying factor becomes the square root of the original multiplying factor.

Hence A₁ = 60,000 × √(63654/60,000)

A₁ = 60,000 × 1.03 = **61,800**

questions.question: Let ∆ABC ∼ ∆QPR and ar (∆ABC) : ar (∆PQR) = 9 : 4. If AB = 9 cm, BC = 6 cm and AC = 12 cm then QR is equal to:
questions.solution:
As similarity of triangles ∆ABC ∼ ∆QPR,

Ratio of area of triangles = ratio of squares of similar sides

⇒ 9 : 4 = AC² : QR²

⇒ 9 : 4 = 12² : QR²

⇒ 12 × 12 × 4 / 9 = QR²

⇒ QR = 8 cm.

questions.question: If x⁴ + x⁻⁴ = 2207, (x > 0) then the value of x + x⁻¹ is:
questions.solution:
x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 2207

On adding 2 on both the sides,

x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 2209

(x² + 1/x²)² = (47)²

x² + 1/x² = 47

On adding 2 on both the sides,

x² + 1/x² + 2 = 49

(x + 1/x) = √49

∴ The value of x + x⁻¹ will be 7.
